researchQuestion: Which coordinate should represent Folkenborg Museum without conflating the open-air museum complex, Narvestadbygningen, the historic Folkenborg farm or one visitor address?

result.decisionSummary: Use the named Folkenborg Museum point for the whole open-air museum. Keep Narvestadbygningen and the older Folkenborg farm/locality as separate building and historical-context anchors.

rejectedAnchors.reason: Approximately 2.64 kilometres east of the named museum and unsupported by any museum, building or farm object.
Strong protected-building anchor, but only one component inside the open-air museum.
Important site context and birthplace layer, but not the present museum-complex object.
Useful visitor and organisation control, but an address is not the geometry of the entire museum.
